title: Concept: Content-Security-Policy default-src allows data: URLs
description: `data:` in default-src is inherited by every directive without an explicit value, so inline data URLs become an allowed resource source for scripts, frames and styles alike.
applicability: Responses that send Content-Security-Policy with an explicit default-src directive.
risk: Injected markup points a fallback-governed directive at a data: URL and the payload executes or renders without any external origin; MEDIUM because explicit directives shield the classes they name.
